title: MetamorphicCheckSpec
description: Additive/optional — v0, not frozen. A zero-token NF-009 metamorphic check over an already-stored capsule: records whose *input* collapses to the same value under `transform` form metamorphic pairs, and every pair's *output* MUST satisfy `invariant`. Read-only over the capsule; no model call. The boolean result is emitted as a `code` Score bound to the capsule Merkle root.

records_file.description: JSONL file within the capsule holding the recorded (input, output) records. Default 'tool-calls.jsonl'.

input_field.description: Record field holding the input value used to form metamorphic pairs. Default 'input'.

output_field.description: Record field holding the output value the invariant is asserted over. Default 'output'.

transform.description: Ordered string transforms applied to the input to derive the pairing key. Records with an equal key are metamorphically equivalent inputs. A single transform name or an ordered list (composed left-to-right).

invariant.description: The relation every metamorphic pair's outputs MUST satisfy for the check to pass.

tolerance.description: Slack for the 'numeric_close' (absolute numeric difference) and 'length_within' (absolute string-length difference) invariants. Ignored by exact relations. Default 0.

transformName.description: identity=unchanged; lower=casefold; strip=trim ends; collapse_whitespace=join on single spaces; remove_punctuation=drop ASCII punctuation.

invariantName.description: equal=outputs identical; equal_normalized=identical after lower+strip+collapse_whitespace; numeric_close=|a-b|<=tolerance (numeric outputs); length_within=|len(a)-len(b)|<=tolerance.
